description: `prose --output json examples list` under the default hosted harness prints the INVOCATION_INVALID envelope with `prose cli example list`.

problem.action: Use `cli example list`: `prose --output json cli example list`.

details.reason: `examples list` is a language command, which runs only with a local harness; did you mean `prose --output json cli example list`? Nothing was forwarded or sent. To run the language command, select a local harness with `prose cli harness use <id>`
